startScreen.title: What If Worlds
description: Choose an answer and explain why.

endScreen.title: Journey Complete
endScreen.subtitle: Return to reality with at least one newly suspicious preference.

questions.question: If you could download one skill into your brain instantly (Matrix style), what would it be?
If you could stop time for 24 hours just once, what would you do?
Would you rather be able to speak every language fluently or play every musical instrument perfectly?
If you could have a HUD (Heads-Up Display) in real life, what 3 stats would you want it to show?
If you could un-invent one thing in existence, what would it be?
If you could view your life’s statistics after you die, what one stat would you care about most?
If you could teleport anywhere but your clothes didn't go with you, would you still use it?
If you could talk to animals, which species would be the most annoying to converse with?
If you were the first person to step onto Mars, what would your first words be?
If a zombie apocalypse started right now, what is the first object in this room you'd grab as a weapon?
If you were trapped in a video game for a month, which game would you choose to ensure your survival?
If you had to live in a TV show universe for the rest of your life, which one would it be?
If aliens landed and asked to speak to humanity's leader, who would you send (politicians excluded)?
If you could have dinner with any three fictional characters, who would they be?
If you started a cult, what would it be about and what would your followers wear?
If you were a ghost, who would you haunt and how would you mildly inconvenience them?
Would you rather always say everything on your mind or never be able to speak again?
Would you rather know *how* you die or *when* you die?
Would you rather live in a world without music or a world without movies?
Would you rather be famous for something terrible or unknown for something amazing?
Would you rather always have to enter rooms backwards or always have to somersault out of them?
Would you rather have fingers as long as legs or legs as long as fingers?
Would you rather fight 100 duck-sized horses or 1 horse-sized duck?
Would you rather have a rewind button for your life or a pause button?
